usageNotes: Returns the list of nodes configured within a specific SDN fabric, including per-node IP addresses, protocol-specific interface definitions, and WireGuard peer/key details. Requires SDN.Audit permission on /sdn/fabrics/{fabric_id}; nodes where you lack Sys.Audit or Sys.Modify are silently omitted. Use the 'pending' flag to inspect staged changes before an SDN apply, or 'running' to compare the active kernel/daemon state against stored config.

examples.summary: List all nodes in the 'wg-core' WireGuard fabric, showing only pending (unapplied) config

tips: fabric_id must be 2–8 alphanumeric characters (hyphens allowed in the middle); leading/trailing hyphens are rejected.

The response shape varies by protocol: WireGuard nodes include 'allowed_ips', 'endpoint', 'peers', 'public_key', and 'role'; OSPF/OpenFabric nodes expose 'interfaces'; BGP nodes expose 'interfaces' with interface names only.
The 'digest' field in each node entry can be passed back on write operations to guard against concurrent modifications.
Omitting both 'pending' and 'running' returns the stored/committed configuration — the baseline before any unapplied edits.
